message.content: {"label": "RISKY", "explanation": "The overridden `name` property checks `hasattr(self, '_attr_name')` but `_attr_name` is declared as a class-level attribute (e.g., `_attr_name: str = \"...\"`) in many subclasses, so `hasattr` will always return True for those classes even when the instance hasn't set it, potentially shadowing the intended `self._name` value; however, the real risk is that `entity.Entity` already defines `_attr_name` (defaulting to `None`), so `hasattr` will always be True and the guard `self._attr_name is not None` becomes the only check—this changes the name resolution order for all `BaseZhaEntity` subclasses that don't set `_attr_name`, which could silently break entity naming for existing entities if the base class attribute is ever non-None."}
